# Golden vectors for the first-party ULID and BIP-39 ports

`ulid_golden.tsv` (1000 lines: hex `u128`, canonical string, `timestamp_ms`) and
`bip39_golden.tsv` (500 lines: hex entropy, English phrase; 100 per entropy size)
were produced by the ORIGINAL crates — `ulid 1.2.1` and `bip39 2.2.2` — right
before they were removed from the workspace. The unit tests in
`src/ulid.rs` and `src/identity/mnemonic.rs` replay every line in both
directions, so the ports stay byte-identical to what those crates persisted.

The generator is deterministic (splitmix64, seeds in the file headers), so the
files regenerate byte-for-byte. It is NOT a workspace member on purpose: a member
would put both crates straight back into `Cargo.lock`. To regenerate, build this
throwaway crate anywhere outside the workspace and copy the two files here:

```toml
[package]
name = "goldgen"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
[dependencies]
ulid = "=1.2.1"
bip39 = "=2.2.2"
```

```rust
//! Golden-vector generator for hippius-mem-core's first-party ULID and BIP-39
//! ports, run against the original crates. Deterministic: splitmix64 seeded
//! with SEED, so the fixtures regenerate byte-for-byte.
use std::fmt::Write as _;

const SEED: u64 = 0x5EED_2026_0825;

struct SplitMix64(u64);
impl SplitMix64 {
    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_add(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
        let mut z = self.0;
        z = (z ^ (z >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
        z = (z ^ (z >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
        z ^ (z >> 31)
    }
    fn next_u128(&mut self) -> u128 {
        (u128::from(self.next_u64()) << 64) | u128::from(self.next_u64())
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut rng = SplitMix64(SEED);
    let mut ulid_out = String::new();
    writeln!(ulid_out, "# ULID golden vectors generated by the `ulid` crate 1.2.1: hex u128, canonical string, timestamp_ms.").unwrap();
    writeln!(ulid_out, "# Deterministic (splitmix64 seed {SEED:#x}); see README.md in this directory to regenerate.").unwrap();
    for i in 0..1000 {
        // Mix realistic timestamps (2016..2100) in with fully random words so both
        // the time and random halves are exercised.
        let value = if i % 2 == 0 {
            rng.next_u128()
        } else {
            let ts = 1_460_000_000_000u64 + rng.next_u64() % 2_700_000_000_000u64;
            ulid::Ulid::from_parts(ts, rng.next_u128()).0
        };
        let u = ulid::Ulid(value);
        writeln!(ulid_out, "{value:032x}\t{u}\t{}", u.timestamp_ms()).unwrap();
    }
    std::fs::write("ulid_golden.tsv", ulid_out).unwrap();

    let mut rng = SplitMix64(SEED ^ 0xB1B3_9000);
    let mut bip_out = String::new();
    writeln!(bip_out, "# BIP-39 golden vectors generated by the `bip39` crate 2.2.2 (English): hex entropy, phrase.").unwrap();
    writeln!(bip_out, "# 100 phrases per entropy size 16/20/24/28/32 bytes. Deterministic (splitmix64 seed {:#x}); see README.md.", SEED ^ 0xB1B3_9000).unwrap();
    for size in [16usize, 20, 24, 28, 32] {
        for _ in 0..100 {
            let mut entropy = vec![0u8; size];
            for chunk in entropy.chunks_mut(8) {
                let w = rng.next_u64().to_be_bytes();
                chunk.copy_from_slice(&w[..chunk.len()]);
            }
            let m = bip39::Mnemonic::from_entropy(&entropy).unwrap();
            let hex: String = entropy.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
            writeln!(bip_out, "{hex}\t{m}").unwrap();
        }
    }
    std::fs::write("bip39_golden.tsv", bip_out).unwrap();
    println!("ok");
}
```
